title: BSIM4 A2 clamp state of the 43-parameter cards: audit and fix, sky130 77 K, 18 devices
done_before: mechanism check nmos_L0p19_W7 and nmos_L1_W1p6 start cards (C curve1 == L curve1, U curves2-11 == L curves2-11, exact)
listing of stored a2 values: a2 > 1 on nmos_L0p19_W7, nmos_L0p25_W1p6, nmos_L20_W0p64, nmos_L8_W1p6, pmos_L0p35_W1p6 in every 43-parameter arm; none < 0.01

states.L: legacy batch deck: first curve clamped, later curves card value
states.C: clamp written into the card (a2>1 -> a2=1, a1=0; a2<0.01 -> 0.01): every curve in the fresh-process state
states.U: warm-up op before the curves: every curve card value (audit only)

fix_rule.valid_card: every curve evaluated in one clamp state
fix_rule.invariance_required: published cards and every card with 0.01 <= a2 <= 1: C score == L score, difference 0 (unit-tested)
fix_rule.other_clamps: listed with bsim4_check_messages; any hit on a stored card -> amendment extending the fix before the reruns

audit.t1_tables: refitted from stored E1 records per fold (deterministic)

validity.V2: C == L == U exactly for unclamped cards

rerun_state_C.records: E1 real_dev + real_test start-card records re-collected -> I13_1/records; unclamped devices identical to stored
rerun_state_C.i12_1_lodo: recipe unchanged, stored penalty grids (single nested dc, already state C) -> I13_1/lodo

metric: strict paper RRMS, inclusion frozen to the published card; not redefined
